userStories.title: Reconcile implementer agent SYSTEM PROMPT to the injected-story model
userStories.description: As the cam harness maintainer, I need the subagent-implementer SYSTEM PROMPT (both the .claude and templates copies) to state that the story to implement is provided in the spawn prompt, so that the agent instructions no longer contradict the sidecar's 'do not self-select' directive and the context-diet is realized.
acceptanceCriteria: In both .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md and templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md, the frontmatter description (line ~3) no longer claims the worker 'picks highest-priority story not yet done'. [oracle: file-assert: ! grep -q 'picks highest-priority' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && ! grep -q 'picks highest-priority' templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md]

The 'find the highest-priority story where passes: false' selection instruction (line ~35), the jq self-selection block (lines ~48-55), and the 'skip entries with requires: operator when picking' selection-logic sentence (line ~69) are removed or rewritten to state the story is provided in the spawn prompt, in BOTH copies. [oracle: file-assert: ! grep -q 'highest-priority story where' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && ! grep -q 'highest-priority story where' templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md && ! grep -q 'select(.passes==false' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && ! grep -q 'select(.passes==false' templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md && ! grep -q 'when picking' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && ! grep -q 'when picking' templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md]

The new wording mirrors the already-reconciled scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md phrasing ('The story to implement is provided in the spawn prompt ...; you do not read prd.json in full to self-select it'), in BOTH copies. [oracle: file-assert: grep -q 'provided in the spawn prompt' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && grep -q 'provided in the spawn prompt' templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md]

The worker's write of prd.json to flip passes:true for the completed story (step at line ~111) is PRESERVED; only SELECTION instructions were reconciled, not all prd.json access. [oracle: file-assert: grep -q 'passes: true' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && grep -q 'passes: true' templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md]
The requires:operator concept explanation (agent md line ~67) remains as context; only the dead selection-logic sentence was touched. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Vendor drift check passes after regenerating the embedded copy (bun run embed-vendor then bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
